summary: Make products and content discoverable without magical ranking promises.

lessons.title: Keyword research and commercial intent
prerequisites: Complete the web foundations or know how to open the project, edit a file, and verify the result in a browser. No previous commercial experience is required.
objectives: Turn Keyword research and commercial intent into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.
Turn a keyword-to-page intent map into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

Turn Connect queries, customer language, informational or transactional intent, difficulty, and the page that can genuinely satisfy demand. into concrete, measurable decisions that can be applied to a real store.

blocks.text: Connect queries, customer language, informational or transactional intent, difficulty, and the page that can genuinely satisfy demand. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Keyword research and commercial intent is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Connect queries, customer language, informational or transactional intent, difficulty, and the page that can genuinely satisfy demand. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Keyword research and commercial intent, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a keyword-to-page intent map. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.

items.definition: A central Keyword research and commercial intent concept defined by an observable rule rather than preference.
A measure or structure that makes the Keyword research and commercial intent decision comparable and reproducible.
A control boundary used to verify that Keyword research and commercial intent improves the system without moving the problem elsewhere.

blocks.title: General application
blocks.text: Apply Keyword research and commercial intent to one small page or campaign before scaling it. Document reusable rules, exceptions, and stopping criteria so another person can reproduce the decision without depending on your memory.

items: Manually review the template with a real product and a narrow mobile viewport

blocks.text: Create guides, comparisons, and answers from customer questions, connect them to categories, and earn mentions without deceptive link buying. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Helpful content, internal links, and authority is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Create guides, comparisons, and answers from customer questions, connect them to categories, and earn mentions without deceptive link buying. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Helpful content, internal links, and authority, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers an editorial calendar and internal-link map. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.
